_note: The person generator (v2/sim/people_gen.gd, roadmap M1 piece 1). Guards, prisoners and recruits are rolled from these lists: a name, an age, a background (sets tech 0-5 and a skill), a motive (what keeps them with you, or what they want), one or two traits, and a line. Guard tiers: low = slate grey and dark blue (the lowly guards you fight first), high = the flame-orange units (later). All text is placeholder the user may rewrite.

backgrounds.name: Mill hand
backgrounds.line: Twelve hours a day at the looms. Strong hands.

backgrounds.name: Mechanic
backgrounds.line: Fixes anything with an engine, and some things without.

backgrounds.name: Nurse
backgrounds.line: Hospital night shifts. Steady with a needle.

backgrounds.name: Records clerk
backgrounds.line: Knows how the forms work, and who signs them.

backgrounds.name: Student
backgrounds.line: Expelled for a pamphlet. Good with machines.

backgrounds.name: Electrician
backgrounds.line: Wired half the district. Knows where the cables go.

backgrounds.name: Army deserter
backgrounds.line: Walked away from a checkpoint with his rifle. They want it back.

backgrounds.name: Dock worker
backgrounds.line: Lifts crates. Knows which ones get waved through.

backgrounds.name: Tram driver
backgrounds.line: Knows every street and every patrol's coffee break.

backgrounds.name: Canteen cook
backgrounds.line: Feeds people. People talk to people who feed them.

backgrounds.name: Schoolteacher
backgrounds.line: Taught the approved curriculum for twenty years. Not anymore.

backgrounds.name: Radio repairman
backgrounds.line: Builds receivers that hear the banned stations.

motives.name: Grief
motives.line: They took someone. Nothing else matters much.

motives.name: Money
motives.line: Family to feed. Pays the bills, asks few questions.

motives.name: Pride
motives.line: Wants to be good at something that matters.

motives.name: Family
motives.line: Doing this so their kids don't have to.

motives.name: Belief
motives.line: Believes the country can be different.

motives.name: Friendship
motives.line: Came because a friend did. Stays for the friend.

motives.name: Revenge
motives.line: Has a name in mind. Wants to be there when it happens.

motives.name: Thrill
motives.line: Bored to death of the state. This is the first time they feel awake.

lines: Nineteen years and still on nights.
Took the job for the ration card.
Hates the depot, hates the cold, hates you.
Two kids. Wants to go home.
Thinks the alarm button is a myth.

offenses: Late for curfew by four minutes
Complained about the rations in a queue
Wrong colour coat on Marshal's Day
Lent a book with a missing page
recruit_hooks: Heard from a friend you're hitting the old warehouse.
Saw your post on Nod. Wants in.
Worked there for six years before they let them go.
Their brother is in the holding cells.
